representedDate: Restored visitor estate, approximate current architecture
wholePhysicalScope: The standing Lares hacienda visitor precinct at the municipality’s published location, with the timber casa grande, coffee-processing balcony range, courtyard-side dependencies and the glácil drying terrace.
lodDetails: All four levels keep the mapped hillside roof groups, timber casa grande, balcony range and drying terrace. Near levels add shutter, rail, terrace stair and mill-wheel detail.
limitations: The main visitor buildings use the municipality’s published site, about 2.3 km from the Qualla article’s locality marker. The individual building functions and the drying terrace’s exact orientation are inferred from the mapped roofs, farm documentation and slope.
